name: Loongson Technology Corporation Limited
summary: Loongson Technology Corporation Limited engages in the research, development, production, sale, and service of processor chips in China. The company offers processors, such as IT systems, industrial control embedded system, and loongson companion chip. It also provides Loongnix operating system that offers services for personal computers, servers, and cloud computing in the generalized informatization field; LoongOS, an industrial control operating system; Loongson Browser; and firmware. In addition, the company offers cloud terminals, computer, laptop, and desktop; dual-way, four-ways, high-density, and storage server; load balancing, switch, ethernet layer 3 switch, bastion machine, VPN, data gateway, high-performance firewall, GAP, and cipher machine; RTU, PLC, DCS controller mainboard, industrial core controller, industrial edge gateway, and industrial robots; intelligent door lock, treadmill, electric moped, and water meter; and industry self-service terminal equipment, question answering robot, intelligent blackboard, integrated operation and maintenance machine, DNS, lottery betting machine, safety filing cabinet, and self service terminal. Further, it provides ATM, high speed camera, and financial self-service terminal; power gateway and PLC, DCS controller mainboard, power GAP, power quality monitoring device, and clock synchronization device; and transportation industry solutions. Loongson Technology Corporation Limited was incorporated in 2008 and is headquartered in Beijing, China.
